notes.title: FLASHOUT III Announced! Coming in 2022! Add to your wishlist!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello all Jujubee fans! Today we have some great news to announce:

FLASHOUT is back and is racing into Steam this very year! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

[h3]YEEES… FLASHOUT IS BACK![/h3]

Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. This is where the world of [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] will take you and your ride to the absolute limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/35475072352a1c1b763332fc75947d2e4b3680d7.gif[/img]

[b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] will offer you ultra-fast ships, loops, jumps and sudden razor-sharp turns! You will have the chance to test your racing skills on the most impressive sci-fi circuits and try not to fall behind! But if it happens, don't sweat! Unleash the power of rockets, guns, bombs and mines to help you level down your competition!

[previewyoutube=NiSL2s8E9Ig;full][/previewyoutube]
In [b]FLASHOUT 3[/b] you will take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish! Witness spectacular crashes, the agony of defeat, and the sweet taste of victory! But don't blink! It can all end in a flash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/6da6f2126bff8f236d9bfec883bca9ae3a5e39f5.gif[/img]

FLASHOUT was also always about music, so expect great and unique electronic tunes!

[b]Steam users can expect a playable demo version by the end of May! [/b]The full version of the game is coming later this year to PC (Windows, Mac, Linux)!

Make sure to wishlist the game!

[h2]WISHLIST NOW:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870

[url=https://www.facebook.com/JujubeeGames]Follow JUJUBEE on Facebook[/url]

Til the next one!

notes.title: PUNK WARS DEMO AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the PUNK WARS playable demo is now available!

PUNK WARS is a combat-heavy twist on a classic turn-based 4X strategy where steam, steel, atom and diesel-punk corporations clash to spread their technology and the way of life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222679/9a5fb440bcd93dbdc85174d4ae7ae759011a1a7a.gif[/img]

Just on the side note please note that the game is still in development and that the demo comes from the pre-alpha version. Some features might not be available yet and some are not final. We have decided to release the demo based on an early version of the game also to confirm we are heading the right direction. We want to engage the community into the development of the game as much as possible. So in case you have any feedback or suggestions make sure to share them on the Steam Community page or on our Discord channel. Also don't forget to wishlist the game. Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663880/

The Strategy Forge Team

[url=https://discord.gg/cYSjF6myeM]Our Discord channel[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.14 (+ Incoming Steam Trading Cards!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope everyone is doing fine.

We've just updated our game with another set of small fixes, so we hope you will enjoy them on your playthroughs! We've also included the addition of Steam Trading Cards! They should be available quite soon, so be ready for those notifications :)

[b]Patch Notes 1.14[/b]
[list]
[*]small bug fixes
[*]a couple of Quality of Life fixes
[/list]

Thank you for sticking with us and we're extremely happy to see that you guys are enjoying the game! If you notice a bug, or if you have any suggestions - let us know by leaving a comment here or by creating a thread on Steam!

Until next time!

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Tuesday has brought us another patch for COVID: The Outbreak, so we hope this one will fix some of the issues you have encountered during your playthroughs:

[b]Patch Notes 1.05[/b]
[list]
[*]keys [ and ] will now enable you to change the game's speed
[*]pressing r,f,v will center the view on a particular unit
[*]improved project status visibility:
blue - available
green - implemented
blue-green blinking - in progress
red - locked
[*]fixed bug where resources were loaded on the 5th day
[*]small hotkeys fixes
[*]fixed some small minor bugs (including visual ones)
[*]fixed bug where if the event text was long and had a scroll, the scroll wasn't on the very top
[*]fixed the missing Polish subtitle in the intro video
[*]fixed bug where the scroll didn't work in the save window
[*]fixed some resolution bugs during credits
[*]pressing the C key will now also change the map mode on the right side to the Panic mode
[*]changing the map mode via a hot key will now avoid turning on/off units
[/list]

There you go! Another day makes our game that much better! Thank you for your continuous support!

Until next time guys!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're kicking off the week with a brand new patch 1.04 which adds some interesting things, some of which you have requested, so let's dive in and check them out:

[b]Patch Notes 1.04[/b][list]
[*]fixed a crash bug when exiting the game
[*]new hotkeys added:
1. GHO window
2. Country Info
3. Buildings
4. Projects
5. Decrees
6. Vaccine
7. Simulation
Q/E - Zoom in/out
R - select Security Unit (multiple pressing of the key will switch between units if we have more of them)
F - select Specialist Unit
V - select Diplomat Unit
C - Panic Map
Z,X - change map mode
WASD - camera control
[*] improved optimization
[*] fixed a bug with the Headquarters being built once more
[*] some balance changes
[*] Vaccine Research: now slots will swap objects when you put one into the other
[*] some small fixes
[/list]

That's it! Let us know how are these changes holding up in the game and if you happen to come across a bug let us know in the comments or create a new thread in the Steam discussions.

Thank you and until next time!

notes.title: Help Us Fight COVID-19!
notes.notes:
Greetings,

The world we live in is currently enveloped by the dreaded COVID-19 pandemic. This lingering disease is a formidable opponent and we all have to be aware that it is going to stay with us for a little while before a vaccine is developed. 

This brings us to the topic at hand as Jujubee would like to declare its participation in fighting this coronavirus head-on. We've decided that [b]20%[/b] of all our net Steam sales throughout the month of May and June will be donated to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) and other charitable foundations supporting the fight against the consequences of the coronavirus pandemic. 

By supporting us, you are supporting the development of the vaccine that we all desperately need and for that - we thank you!

[b]Wishlist the game here:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287000 

Stay safe everyone and let's win this battle against this invisible enemy!


Yours truly,
Jujubee Team
